[R4] Fact: New user-facing error messages (`message`) must be in German, because the warehouse staff UI shows them verbatim to the packers. The `code` field stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
    Rubric: 2 = German messages AND (the reason: warehouse staff UI shows them verbatim, OR the English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE code convention). | 1 = German messages only, with neither reason nor code convention.
[R5] Fact: Never log the recipient's name, address or phone number (personal data). Reason: GDPR; the data protection officer flagged exactly this in last month's audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine.
    Rubric: 2 = Recipient personal data (name/address/phone or 'recipient PII') AND GDPR/DPO/audit reason. | 1 = Recipient personal data without a reason, or a generic 'no PII' without saying recipient data.
[D1] Fact: Austrian public holidays for 2026 and 2027 are a hardcoded list in src/services/holidays.ts (no holiday API). Reason: the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet access, so it must work fully offline.
    Rubric: 2 = Hardcoded/static list (no API) AND the no-outbound-internet / offline reason. | 1 = Hardcoded list without the reason.
[D2] Fact: Max 3 attempts in total, fixed 30-second delay, no exponential backoff. Reason: the ERP deduplicates by event_id only within a 2-minute window, so all attempts must land within 2 minutes or duplicates are created.
    Rubric: 2 = 3 attempts + fixed 30 s / no backoff AND the 2-minute dedup-window reason. | 1 = Correct parameters without the reason, or the reason with partly wrong parameters.
[D3] Fact: No. Keep the JSON file store (writes are debounced at 200 ms instead). Reason: ops backs up data/store.json with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files; a binary SQLite file would break their backup checks.
    Rubric: 2 = Keep JSON / no SQLite AND the ops rsync/plain-text backup reason. | 1 = Keep JSON / no SQLite without the (correct) reason.
[D4] Fact: Only ATP (Austrian Post) numbers are validated, as UPU S10 incl. mod-11 check digit. All other carriers: any non-empty value. Reason: their formats change too often; last year valid DHL numbers were rejected for two days.
    Rubric: 2 = ATP-only S10/check-digit validation, others accept anything non-empty, AND the 'formats change too often / DHL incident' reason. | 1 = ATP-only validation without the reason.
[X1] Fact: fs.watch was tried and never fires on staging, because the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host and file change events don't propagate into the container. Polling with fs.watchFile worked.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker
<!-- gemkeeper ledger. Written for the next session. Keep it under ~120 lines. Edit in place. -->
Updated: 2026-11-17

## Mission
- Work on parcel-tracker (shipment tracking service, Vienna warehouse; Node 24 runs TS directly, no build step, zero deps). Task 1: calculateEta (src/services/eta.ts) must skip Austrian public holidays, not just weekends; add tests + run them.
- User works autonomously-style: reviews everything at the end (user).

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites the folder every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- (user) No new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies — each new package needs security review (~6 weeks).

## Decisions
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must stay byte-for-byte unchanged (no added/removed/renamed fields) — mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release is January. New fields (e.g. `eta` on list items) go only on GET /shipments. Don't touch shipmentToApi in a way that leaks into /:id.
- (user) Tracking-number validation: ONLY carrier ATP gets UPU S10 check-digit validation (algorithm in docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — because their formats change often and last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for two days.
- (user) Austrian public holidays = hardcoded list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, no holiday API — because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet; must work fully offline.

## Rules (cont.)
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (shown verbatim to warehouse packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

## Rules (cont. 2)
- (user) NEVER log recipient name, address or phone anywhere (GDPR personal data; data protection officer flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK to log.

## Facts
- `npm start` = node src/server.ts; `npm test` = node --test (files in test/). Env: PORT, DATA_FILE, ERP_URL; config/default.json.
- (user) Test 'emits webhook on delivered' (test/events.test.ts) is flaky (~1 in 5 on CI, timer race in fake notifier), tracked OPS-412, owned by platform team: if it fails, rerun once, do NOT try to fix it.
- .gemkeeper/ is not in .gitignore (open question below).

## Facts (ERP)
- ERP webhook signing: `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 (secret env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET) over JSON body WITHOUT the `sig` field, sent as top-level `sig` in the body (src/services/notify.ts, src/config.ts). Unset secret → unsigned + one warning (my choice; rollout ERP-1182).
- ERP payload now uses documented names event_id, shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, event_type, occurred_at (toErpPayload in src/services/notify.ts; test/erp-payload.test.ts). Optional `note` NOT sent (free carrier text, not requested).

## Decisions (cont.)
- (user) ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30 s delay, no exponential backoff, on network error or 5xx — because the ERP dedupes by event_id only within a 2-minute window; all attempts must land inside it or the ERP gets duplicate events. Delay must be injectable for tests.

- (user) Keep the JSON file store (data/store.json); do NOT move to SQLite (node:sqlite) — ops backs it up with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files, a binary DB breaks their backup checks. Slowness is solved by debouncing writes in src/store.ts (200 ms window, one write per window) + flush() on shutdown.

- ETA is computed fresh on every call (memoization was removed). Measured: ETA part of a 500-item list is <2 ms, it was never the bottleneck of the slow GET /shipments on staging (166-348 ms already BEFORE eta existed). Plan (user): paginate the list endpoint later.

## Dead ends
- (user) X-Signature header for ERP webhooks (implemented, deployed to staging) → ERP's API gateway strips ALL custom X- headers, so every webhook arrived "unsigned". Never put auth/signature in custom headers; use the JSON body.

- (user) Batching ERP events (array of up to 50 per POST) — suggested by a teammate, user tried it in Sept 2026 → ERP answers 422 to any array payload; it only accepts ONE event object per request. Don't build it.

- (user) ERP sandbox listens on port 9911 since the October infra move; docs/erp-api.md and README still say 8080 (outdated). docs/erp-api.md is owned by the ERP team: do NOT edit it. User fixes the README themself. config/default.json still has erp.url localhost:8080 (not changed yet, flagged).
- (user) Future need (nothing to build now): hot reload of config/default.json. fs.watch NEVER fires on staging (config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host, change events don't propagate into the container); fs.watchFile (polling) worked. Use polling, not fs.watch.

- (user) ETA memoization/caching of calculateEta → QA found stale ETAs in the list after a new event (e.g. exception); a proper cache key got messy. Removed completely; caching ETAs is a dead end, don't re-add. (My version keyed on carrier|level|start|exceptionCount and its unit tests showed invalidation working, so the QA staleness was NOT reproduced locally — cause unknown.)

## Open questions
- Commit or ignore .gemkeeper/ledger.md?
- Fixture data/fixtures/shipments.sample.json has 7 ATP numbers with bad check digits.

## Now
- Done: holidays, ATP validation, ERP sig/retries/payload names, eta on list items (computed fresh, memoization removed + test/eta-cache.test.ts deleted), request logging, debounced store; 93/93 tests pass.
- Next step: await user review / next task (list pagination planned by user for later; open: config/default.json erp.url 8080 vs 9911; fixture check digits; commit-or-ignore .gemkeeper/).
